related.title: Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對整合式壓水模組與共用水池；Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程改以小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integral pwr modules and a shared pool; Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering centers on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照整合模組熱流體邊界與小型BWR蒸汽邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以US600文檔審查界面為起點，設計一項能區分「整合式壓水模組與共用水池」與「小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare integral-module fluid boundaries with small-bwr steam boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from us600 document-review boundary and propose an observation distinguishing integral pwr modules and a shared pool from small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages, including uncertainty.

related.title: CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「縮尺整體效應試驗的功率比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Power scaling in a reduced-scale integral test" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of CAREM-25 Integral PWR Prototype must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦一體化模組的定量檢核：自然循環、整體效應試驗、共用水池熱沉與首座計畫的成本；CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆則以阿根廷自主設計的一體化原型堆：自穩壓、爐內蒸汽產生器、自然循環與放大的經濟性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of an integral module: natural circulation, integral testing, the shared pool as heat sink and the cost of the first project; CAREM-25 Integral PWR Prototype centres on argentina's own integral prototype: self-pressurisation, in-vessel steam generators, natural circulation and the economics of scaling up, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的模型移到CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「自然循環的驅動壓頭」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Driving head of natural circulation" to CAREM-25 Integral PWR Prototype, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Driving head of natural circulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「縮尺整體效應試驗的功率比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；CAREM-25 一體化壓水原型堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Power scaling in a reduced-scale integral test" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of CAREM-25 Integral PWR Prototype must be respecified.

related.title: 玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆
related.titleEn: Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「縮尺整體效應試驗的功率比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Power scaling in a reduced-scale integral test" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦一體化模組的定量檢核：自然循環、整體效應試驗、共用水池熱沉與首座計畫的成本；玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆則以首座陸上商用小型模組化壓水堆：一體化壓力槽、模組整體吊裝與汽電海水淡化共生為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of an integral module: natural circulation, integral testing, the shared pool as heat sink and the cost of the first project; Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor centres on the first land-based commercial small modular PWR: an integral vessel, single-lift core module and cogeneration with desalination, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的模型移到玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Driving head of natural circulation" to Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「縮尺整體效應試驗的功率比例」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；玲龍一號 ACP100 小型壓水堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Power scaling in a reduced-scale integral test" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Linglong One ACP100 Small Modular Reactor must be respecified.
